findings: Covers every section in printed order: computational problems and their classes, well- and ill-defined problems, Generate and Test, solvable/unsolvable and tractable/intractable problems, P, NP, NP-hard, NP-complete, Big O, time and space complexity, efficiency, scalability, suitability, divide and conquer, greedy, dynamic programming, backtracking, Bubble and Selection Sort, linear and binary search, BFS and DFS. Traces (sorting passes, binary search, BFS/DFS orders, coin change, Fibonacci, factorials, pair counts) were computed in Python. Book corrections followed: pair comparisons n(n − 1)/2, binary search target 7. None repeats the chapter exercise.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
